channel.title: HRDive – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from HRDive – Bias and Credibility (hrdive.com)

item.title: How compensation teams can become strategic finance partners
item.description: Finance leaders are looking to comp teams for deeper insight into how workforce investments affect the bottom line. Check out these strategies for strengthening that partnership.

item.title: Why performance reviews are now continuous
item.description: Ken Lloyd, author of Performance Appraisals & Phrases for Dummies, spoke with HR Dive about what has shifted in talent development in 15 years.

item.title: Week in review: Feds stay the course on marijuana testing
item.description: We’re rounding up last week’s stories, from negative viewpoints on artificial intelligence to the ROI of skills-based hiring practices.

item.title: A leader downplayed an HR investigation’s findings. What now?
item.description: It’s a difficult place for professionals to find themselves, attorneys told HR Dive, and moving forward requires understanding of both personal and organizational risks.

item.title: Bimbo Bakeries can’t compel Massachusetts drivers to arbitrate misclassification claim
item.description: A federal district court said the drivers can pursue their state law case in court because they qualify as transportation workers excluded from coverage under the FAA.

item.title: DOL sends new joint employer rule to White House
item.description: The forthcoming rule is expected to be friendlier to employers than present Fair Labor Standards Act regulations, one attorney told HR Dive.

item.title: Leaders report a ‘growing gap’ between what’s expected of them and the support they receive
item.description: Most leaders say they perform work outside of their primary roles, according to new research from the American Management Association.

item.title: Enterprises aren’t aligned on AI ROI
item.description: As organizations scale AI, leaders must reconcile the need for immediate returns with the longer-term innovation potential that made the technology compelling in the first place, a TE Connectivity report found.

item.title: Toxic managers dehumanize employees, leading to extreme burnout, study says
item.description: “A human-centric approach to management” that focuses on restoring employee agency could help, a study published in the Journal of Occupational Health Psychology found.

item.title: How AI is spurring demand for skilled trade workers — not displacing them
item.description: “The digital revolution underway has a physical foundation,” Randstad CEO Sander van ’t Noordende said.
